Entity.description: The root every NGSI-LD entity class specialises.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

Entity.title: Entity

Event.description: One public event: its name, its start and a link are required (owner 2026-10-22); its place as a GPS point is expected and filled from the source or the venue table, its organizer kept where the source names one, the rest kept where the source gives it.

address.description: The postal address of the venue, field by field (Smart Data Models' common PostalAddress); `addressLocality` is the town a calendar filters on. A field the source leaves out is absent, never guessed.

areaServed.description: The municipality the event or the venue belongs to, by its official name (`Detva`, `Košice`): the key a count or a filter per town reads, on every event (DM-141).

audience.description: Who the event is for, in Smart Data Models' Event codes; set with the category `children-family`, `children` when the source or the name says children, else `family`.

category.description: The event's main category, one code of the platform's list of 16 (docs API/12-event-categories.md), picked by the rule table seeds/event-categories.json from the source's own word, the name or the kind of body that announced it (`music`, `sport`), else by the decision model's cached answer. A list of one, as Smart Data Models' Event writes `category`; absent while neither has named the event.

categorySource.description: How `category` was picked: `rule` the rule table, `model` the decision model's cached answer for an event no rule decides (scripts/events-classify.py).

dataProvider.description: Who announced the event (the town, the region, the cultural body), as the credit names it.

dateModified.description: When the source last changed the record.

description.description: What the source says about the event, as plain text without markup.

endDate.description: When the event ends, written as `startDate`; for a whole-day event its last day, inclusive. Absent when the source gives no end: the calendar then shows the start alone.

eventCategory.description: The kind of event in the source's own words (`koncert`, `výstava`, `šport`), kept so `category` can be traced back to it.

location.description: Where the event takes place, a GeoJSON Point in WGS 84 inside the source's country (Czechia: longitude 12.0 to 18.9, latitude 48.5 to 51.1; Slovakia: longitude 16.8 to 22.6, latitude 47.7 to 49.7): the source's own point, the venue's building, else the organizer's or the town's office or the town's centre, as `locationPrecision` says (owner 2026-10-21: at least 90 % of events with a point).

locationPrecision.description: How close `location` is to the venue: `source` the publisher's own point, `building` the venue's building (the address register or a venue checked against OpenStreetMap), `office` the organizer's or the town's office standing in for a venue nobody placed, `centre` the town's centre. A map draws `office` and `centre` as approximate.

locationSource.description: Who placed `location`: `feed` the publisher, `register-adries`, `overpass`, `nominatim` or `hand` the venue table's row (seeds/bbsk-events/venues.csv), `towns` the town table's office or centre.

name.description: The title of the event as the source writes it, in its own language (Czech or Slovak).

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

organizer.description: Who runs the event: the museum, the school, the town or the named performer, never the feed or the aggregator that announced it (that is `dataProvider`). Its name and its web site only, never a person's e-mail or phone.

refPointOfInterest.description: The venue as a PointOfInterest of this space, when the venue table placed the event; every event held there links the same one (DM-141).

source.description: The feed or the page the pipeline read the event from.

sourceId.description: The event's own identifier at its source, so a record can be traced back.

startDate.description: When the event starts: an RFC 3339 instant with its offset (`2026-11-14T19:00:00+01:00`, Europe/Bratislava as the source publishes it), or a date alone (`2026-11-14`) for an event that lasts whole days.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

url.description: An http(s) link a person opens: the page of the event at its source, where they read more or buy a ticket, else the organizer's page that lists its events.

venue.description: The name of the place, as the source writes it (a hall, a square, a museum).

Event.title: Event

EventAudience.description: The Smart Data Models Event audience codes the pipelines write.
EventAudience.title: EventAudience

EventCategory.description: The main event categories of the platform, with labels in sk, cs, en and de.
EventCategory.title: EventCategory

x-enum-descriptions.food-market: Smart Data Models category gastronomy, shopping.

LocationPrecision.description: How close an event's point is to its venue; office and centre are approximate.
LocationPrecision.title: LocationPrecision

Organizer.description: The value of `organizer`, never an entity of its own.

name.description: The organizer's name as the source writes it (`Stredoslovenské múzeum`).

url.description: The organizer's own web site, when the source names it.

Organizer.title: Organizer

PointOfInterest.description: One venue of the venue table (seeds/bbsk-events/venues.csv): a hall, a square, a museum where events take place, one entity per real place (table rows of one name within 50 m are one venue), its id the OpenStreetMap object of its building or a hash of its town, name and point (DM-141).

address.description: The postal address of the venue, field by field (Smart Data Models' common PostalAddress); `addressLocality` is the town a calendar filters on. A field the source leaves out is absent, never guessed.

areaServed.description: The municipality the event or the venue belongs to, by its official name (`Detva`, `Košice`): the key a count or a filter per town reads, on every event (DM-141).

dataProvider.description: Who announced the event (the town, the region, the cultural body), as the credit names it.

location.description: The venue's building as a GeoJSON Point in WGS 84 inside the source's country.

name.description: The venue's name (`Dom kultúry A. Sládkoviča`).

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

source.description: The feed or the page the pipeline read the event from.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

PointOfInterest.title: PointOfInterest

PostalAddress.description: The value of `address`, never an entity of its own.

addressCountry.description: The country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

addressLocality.description: The town or the municipality, by its official name with diacritics (`Praha`, `Banská Bystrica`).

addressRegion.description: The self-governing region, by its official name (`Hlavní město Praha`, `Banskobystrický kraj`).

streetAddress.description: The street and the house number.
